test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, BOX is written as OBK, LAY is written as YNL and COP is written as PBC. How will HUNDRED be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d26a4107141c8988092be3a6f971de10fd85269bdcee88518465cc72c114f65.png] 

Given: BOX is written as OBK, LAY is written as YNL, and COP is written as PBC.

The logic followed here is:

Adding 13 to the positional values of the given letters, as shown below,

 
• BOX is written as OBK,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d0a70b0ae42729ff5d55bba54acd6eb1113ea7ed935c458cacd4fca795bb0a4.png] 

 
• LAY is written as YNL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9cb1736b1e54b6d1f602082e0fb507fb1b057f83b7228cf56790e14a16faffd.png] 

And,

 
• COP is written as PBC.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8cf4a5d60a572feb05afbc9eb8de2ee39cbb356f1641fe9603e0b2c92482a6a9.png] 

Similarly,

 
• HUNDRED is coded as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73252d26bbdaf6b4ca8779e030a5c45268483a0319eb87a3a735106658e462e7.png] 

Hence, UHAQERQ is the correct answer.
